title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 23 FEBRUARY 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 22 February 2026 The prevailing heavy rainy conditions are gradually decreasing as the low-pressure area over the southwest Bay of Bengal is moving away from the island. Several spells of showers will occur in Northern, North-central and North-western provinces and in Trincomalee district. Showers may occur in coastal areas in the Kalutara, Galle and Matara district in the morning too. Showers or thundershowers are likely at a few places in Central and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Kalutara, Galle and Matara districts after 2.00 p.m. Fairly heavy falls above 50 mm are likely at some places in these areas. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central, Sabaragamuwa and Uva provinces and in Ampara and Hambantota districts during the early hours of the morning. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
